attempts.text:
The plan rescues 7 elderly people and 7 adults in four round trips from Naukunda shelter. It defers the 4 children at Syaphru school because no open road reaches them. Total cost is 496.

**Why each choice was made**
- **Syaphru school (4 children):** Its only road, from Dupcheshwar market, is impassable, so the children cannot be reached. They are deferred at 4 × 60 = 240.
- **Dupcheshwar market (7 elderly):** The direct road from the shelter is impassable. The open route goes through Shivapuri market and takes 40 minutes each way.
  - Each trip carries up to 4 people, so 2 round trips are needed, costing 80 + 80 = 160.
  - Deferring all 7 instead would cost 350.
  - Doing one trip and deferring 3 would cost 230.
- **Gosaikunda care home and Benighat market (7 adults):**
  - A round trip to Benighat takes 56 minutes and brings back 4 adults.
  - A round trip to Gosaikunda takes 40 minutes and brings back 3 adults.
  - Both trips cost 96. Doing only the Benighat trip and deferring the other 3 would cost 56 + 60 = 116.
- All trips must return to the shelter because it is the only evacuation point.

drive car1 naukunda-shelter shivapuri-market
drive car1 shivapuri-market dupcheshwar-market
load car1 elderly 4
drive car1 dupcheshwar-market shivapuri-market
drive car1 shivapuri-market naukunda-shelter
unload car1 elderly 4
drive car1 naukunda-shelter shivapuri-market
drive car1 shivapuri-market dupcheshwar-market
load car1 elderly 3
drive car1 dupcheshwar-market shivapuri-market
drive car1 shivapuri-market naukunda-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
drive car1 naukunda-shelter gosaikunda-care-home
drive car1 gosaikunda-care-home benighat-market
load car1 adult 4
drive car1 benighat-market gosaikunda-care-home
drive car1 gosaikunda-care-home naukunda-shelter
unload car1 adult 4
drive car1 naukunda-shelter gosaikunda-care-home
load car1 adult 3
drive car1 gosaikunda-care-home naukunda-shelter
unload car1 adult 3
defer syaphru-school child 4
</plan>
